name: gy-tax-overview
description: Guyana tax overview for 2026: the main taxes and their headline figures in one place, each tied to the Guyana statute in the Guyana Revenue Authority (GRA) consolidations. Covers the calendar year of income and the year of assessment that follows it, the GRA, residence (permanent residence or more than 183 days; control and management for companies), personal income tax at 25% up to G$3,360,000 and 35% above with the G$1,680,000 or one-third personal allowance, corporation tax at 25%, 40% and 45% and the 2% minimum tax on commercial companies, 20% withholding tax on payments to non-residents, VAT at 14% with the G$15,000,000 registration threshold, capital gains tax at 20% and the 12-month rule, the 30 April return date, monthly VAT returns by the 21st and PAYE by the 14th. Trigger phrases: Guyana tax overview, how is Guyana taxed, Guyana tax rates 2026, GRA taxes. Detail lives in gy-income-tax, gy-corporate-income-tax, gy-vat-gst, gy-payroll-social, gy-cross-border, gy-company-formati
